title: Conversational AI Context Window Management & Memory
learningObjectives: Design context window management: rolling window, semantic summary, and vector retrieval
Extract structured entities and long-term user preferences from conversational history
Manage token budgets across system prompt, retrieved context, chat history, and generation reserve
keyTradeoffs: Summarization LLM latency and token cost vs loss of verbatim historical dialogue details
Client-side state tracking vs server-managed persistent conversational memory
commonPitfalls: Exceeding LLM context window limits without a graceful compression or truncation policy
Injecting unsanitized user chat history into system prompt instructions (indirect prompt injection)
transferPrompt: How do you combine conversational memory with external vector RAG to answer queries grounded in user history?
